Name: Monteso's Furniture
Author: monteso
Description:
WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE


While looking around town, I noticed that a lot of the villagers had nice looking furniture and decor. Stuff that isn't available to the player. This mod compilation aims to fix that. It combines all four of my furniture mods; Toys for children, Bonsai Trees, Bathroom Furniture, and Gameroom Furniture into one pack. I released each set as their own mod so people can pick one of the four or use this and have them all. As I add more I'll be updating their own mod set and this one.

Included in the optional files is a png asset containing over two dozen tablecloth and tablerunners for the diviner and square tables. Pick and match what combination you like. You will need to edit your own furniture.xnb. This is not a mod only [u]assets[/u].

Updated for Game version 1.1

[u]Install info[/u]
Extract the furniture.xnb form the zip file. Place it in your Stardew Valley/Content/Tilesheets folder and replace.

[u]Install info Content Patcher pack only

[/u][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download mod pack  and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
